notes.title: Joe Biden's Escape From MAGA Chapter 2 Is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
I'm pleased to announce that due to popular demand, I've created a sequel to the smash hit Joe Biden - Escape From MAGA Chapter 1.

You can check out Chapter 2 here https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015850/Joe_Biden_Vs_Jeo_Boden__Escape_From_MAGA_Chapter_2/

This time, an internet Meme coin threatens Mr. 46's presidency. Can Joe survive this latest political assault before November?

Wishlist to find out!
